# MobileFilmLab v0.2.0-beta.2 — dynamic cameras and RAW

**Oppo Find X9 Ultra remains the primary target.** Help expand compatibility by reporting your device, firmware, detected routes and supported formats.

## New

- **Dynamic Camera2 camera selector:** photo-capable rear IDs and physical routes are enumerated instead of four fixed lens slots. Labels use reported focal/sensor metadata; logical multi-camera routes say Auto. Distinct same-category cameras remain individually selectable by ID. Hold a chip for details.
- **JPEG only / RAW DNG only / RAW + JPEG:** choose from the format badge or Settings. Options depend on the selected route's advertised capabilities. An incompatible camera change asks before switching file format.
- **Real sensor DNG:** Camera2 `RAW_SENSOR` data is streamed through `DngCreator` with matching sensor metadata. No JPEG-renamed-as-RAW, recipe grade, grain, RGB correction, digital crop or interpolation is applied to DNG.
- RAW-only requests no still-JPEG stream. RAW+JPEG uses one timestamp-matched request and matching-stem files; looks affect its JPEG only.
- Retained RAW-image ownership across session closure, bounded native stream retries, pending-file publication/rollback, DNG gallery metadata, correct sharing MIME and an external RAW-editor action.
- Camera-ID-specific JPEG calibration preferences with legacy-gain fallback. Existing recipes and favourites remain intact.

## Important limits

Camera2 reports exposed routes, not necessarily every physical lens. A logical Auto route is not another lens. Firmware may hide cameras or reject combinations; there is no private-API/whitelist bypass.

RAW formats use **standard Camera2, uncropped 1× and native pixels**. They do not use OEM HDR/Night, JPEG fusion, ZSL or enlarged export. RAW streams are normal-resolution advertised sizes, bounded at 55MP for memory safety; this is not guaranteed maximum-sensor access. DNG/JPEG dimensions and rendering may differ despite matching capture timestamps.

RAW availability and DNG decoding/metadata still require **real handset validation**. Automated tests do not prove physical capture support. Use a compatible RAW editor; retain another camera for important photos. Unsupported RAW does not silently become a JPEG-only save.

MobileFilmLab adds no generative/ML image enhancement or cloud photo processing. Device firmware/ISP corrections may still apply. Development used substantial AI assistance; see the repository disclosures. UI demonstration scenes are labelled and are not app-captured photographs.

## Install and test

Package `com.mobilefilmlab.camera`, **versionCode 11**, with the same established release key. Install over code 10 rather than uninstalling; confirm recipe/favourite retention and per-camera settings. The owner authorised this beta-version build as the **Latest regular GitHub Release**, not a new `v0.2.0` stable-version build.

- Download the signed APK and verify `checksums.txt`.
- Follow attached `TESTING.md`, especially dynamic-route and RAW checks.
- [Dynamic cameras / RAW details](https://github.com/TheSwagInDisguise/MobileFilmLab/blob/v0.2.0-beta.2/docs/DYNAMIC_CAMERAS_AND_RAW.md)
- [Project website](https://theswagindisguise.github.io/MobileFilmLab/)
- [Report a device or bug](https://github.com/TheSwagInDisguise/MobileFilmLab/issues/new/choose)

Previous binary downloads are withdrawn only after the new build and website are verified. Version tags, source history, attribution and GPL-3.0-or-later licensing remain preserved.
